newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares end off on weak company earnings.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares end off on weak company earnings.

text.p: Chilean shares closed sharply lower on wave of selling by investors disappointed by poor company nine-month earnings, said traders.
The negative sentiment is expected to drag stocks down at the opening, although the market may be buoyed by a mild technical rebound, they said.
"There doesn't appear to be any new news which could help the market rise in any sustained way," said one dealer.
The selective IPSA index ended unofficially down 1.17 percent at 97.73 points. The general IGPA index shed 0.76 percent at 5,355.92 points.
Volume swelled to 16.7 billion pesos from 12.5 billion pesos Tuesday. Although investors had been anticipating weak results, most figures were worse than the bourse had expected, said traders.
The only exception was drug-maker LabChile which reported nine month net earnings climbing to 3.9 billion pesis from 1.8 billion pesos in the same period last year.
The company's stock firmed 1.6 percent to 318 pesos.
Analysts said earnings have been hurt by a combination of a slowdown in the economy as the result of the central bank's tight monetary policy and lower international commodity prices.
